headline: I design the trust before
I design the interface.
about.lead: I'm Timi. For the last few years I've built brands and marketing for teams in finance, food, healthcare and hospitality — identities, campaigns, social, email, and the internal and external comms that hold a company's voice together. Now I'm moving that same eye for clarity and trust into product design, one case study at a time.
about.body: I care about the details that make work feel considered: honest spacing, restrained type, systems that hold up. I want what I make to live in production, not just sit in a deck.
about.quote: "Good design earns trust before it asks for attention. I try to design the trust first — the interface is what carries it."
